question.text: Under the SEBI (AIF) Regulations 2012, the Compliance Test Report (CTR) referenced in Ch 12 is required to be filed by the Investment Manager:

answer.text: At the end of every financial year, certifying compliance with SEBI (AIF) Regulations and circulars issued thereunder.
Every quarter, along with the quarterly NAV report.
Only at the time of PPM registration and no further filings.

explanation.text: The Logic: Annexure 12.1: CTR is filed at the end of every financial year furnishing compliance details with SEBI (AIF) Regulations and circulars. LPs will specifically request the latest CTR during DDQ. The Trap: B, C, D are fabricated cadences. Cross-Exam Context: Compliance reporting cadence also on III-A/C. The CTR is the single-most-scrutinised AIF compliance filing. Manager's Pro-Tip: File the CTR BEFORE the LP asks for it. If any observation exists, pair it with a signed auditor remediation letter. LPs equate 'timely CTR with zero adverse observations' to investment-grade compliance.
